@@U00476@@
Don't you hear? Pleasure means nothing to me. I dedicate myself herewith to the frenzy of dissipation, to joy that is pain, and pain joy, to adoring hatred, and hatred that is love, to torments that refresh, and refreshing exhaustion. My soul healed of the lust for knowledge, I lay myself open to the world’s pain and suffering. In my innermost self I will experience all that humankind experiences, the heights and the depths, the sorrows and delights, and doing so expand myself to encompass all of humanity, and, in the end, shatter like a ship in a storm.

@@U00478@@
Oh, believe me, I’ve gnawed away at these iron rations for millennia and have learned only one thing: there’s no man, none, from womb to tomb, has ever digested this bitter dough! Take it from one of us, this totality of creation, the universe, is made only for a god! I's he who dwells in eternal light, us he casts into darkness, while you must make do with day and night.

@@U00480@@
But I will!

@@U00482@@
Good! I like your spirit! But there’s only one thing frightens me: Time is short, my friend, and art is long.
translation:
@@U00476@@
你没听见吗？快乐对我来说毫无意义。我在此献身于放纵的疯狂，献身于痛苦中的喜悦，痛苦中的喜悦，崇拜仇恨，仇恨即爱，献身于令人耳目一新的折磨，以及令人耳目一新的疲惫。我的灵魂治愈了对知识的渴望，我向世界的痛苦和磨难敞开了心扉。在我的内心深处，我将体验人类所经历的一切，高低，悲伤和快乐，并以此扩展自己以包容全人类，最终像暴风雨中的船一样破碎。

@@U00478@@
哦，相信我，我已经啃了这些铁口粮几千年了，只学到了一件事：没有人，没有人，从子宫到坟墓，曾经消化过这种苦涩的面团！从我们每个人的角度来看，整个造物，即宇宙，只是为一位神而创造的！我是住在永恒光明中的他，他却把我们扔进黑暗里，而你却必须应付白天和黑夜。

@@U00480@@
但我会的！

@@U00482@@
好！我喜欢你的精神！但只有一件事让我害怕：时间很短，我的朋友，而艺术很长。
